recognize_zh: 大型單核芽細胞核質比高、染色質細緻、細胞質灰藍，細胞質內含單一顆大型、圓形、粉紅色（嗜天青性）的包涵體，有時周圍有透明暈（箭頭），即急性單核芽球白血病中的假 Chediak-Higashi 巨大顆粒。
features: Large blasts with round to folded nuclei, fine lacy chromatin and occasional nucleoli
Moderate grey-blue cytoplasm, consistent with monoblasts
Single large, round, pink-to-orange (azurophilic) cytoplasmic inclusion in many blasts (arrows)
Some inclusions surrounded by a clear halo or appearing vacuolated
Low-power field with increased circulating blasts among red cells; occasional neutrophil
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows increased circulating large blasts with round to folded nuclei, fine chromatin, visible nucleoli and moderate grey-blue cytoplasm consistent with monoblasts. Many blasts contain a single large, round, pink-orange azurophilic cytoplasmic inclusion, some surrounded by a clear halo. Residual neutrophils do not contain giant granules. Findings are consistent with acute monoblastic leukemia with pseudo-Chediak-Higashi granules; the inclusions represent abnormal fused primary granules and should be confirmed with cytochemistry (nonspecific esterase, MPO) and flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: The inherited disorder shows giant granules in all mature granulocytes, monocytes and lymphocytes with albinism and infections, rather than inclusions confined to leukemic blasts.
APL cells have bilobed nuclei and heavy fine granules or bundles of Auer rods rather than a single large round inclusion, and are strongly MPO positive.

ddx.dx: Auer rods in AML with maturation
ddx.vs: Auer rods are slender, needle-shaped crystalline rods rather than large round globules.
Engulfed red cells or debris sit in a vacuole with RBC-like size and staining, whereas pseudo-Chediak-Higashi granules are MPO/esterase-reactive granule aggregates.
